stops.name: Parco naturale delle Lame del Sesia
stops.detail: The natural park of the Lame del Sesia is a protected natural area located in Piedmont, along the banks of the river Sesia, it affects the province of Vercelli with the municipalities of Greggio, Albano Vercellese and Oldenico, located on the right horographic, and the municipality of Villata on the left bank. In the province of Novara the park also extends in the municipality of San Nazzaro Sesia.
